items.claim: `inDialog` ignores the row's `disabled`, so the dialog still opens and writes
A matrix cell that aliases an enum opens a dropdown and stays open after a choice
An uncontrolled panel's auto set never follows a new `schema`
items.note: This was a behavior call, now recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. The set starts afresh when the schema's leaf paths or start-auto paths change. It is kept across a schema that is resolved anew with the same ones, because `resolveConfigSchema` returns a new object on every call. So two trials of one shape in one mounted panel share pins, unless the lab keys the panel by trial.
